_about: The headline and one line for each Fan Battle, keyed by gameId. CC drafts them from the news before each battle, Pete approves, and they go live with the next deploy. A game with no entry uses the plain wording in src/lib/headlines.ts. Keep to trash talk, form and injuries from a named news source, and never anything about a player's private life.
